capabilities: Insert and edit interactive tables with typed columns
Sort, filter, and reorder rows and columns
Convert existing Markdown pipe tables into Smart Tables
Export tables as CSV with current sorting and filtering
Edit colors and options for Status, Select, and Multi-select columns
extras: Data is stored in the note as a single-line JSON fenced code block, so tables sync and version like regular text; the README advises editing through the grid rather than by hand.
problem: Plain Markdown pipe tables are static text with no types, sorting, filtering, or row/column management, so managing structured data in notes is awkward.
summary: Interactive database-style tables stored as JSON code blocks, with typed columns, sorting, filtering, status pills, and CSV export.
